workflows.title: Build and review Klipper configuration
workflows.summary: Import known-good .cfg files, complete guided printer, ERCF, and Blobifier fields, preserve advanced sections, preview diffs, back up, and apply with rollback.

steps.title: Import or start blank
steps.instructions: Import one or more known-good Klipper or Happy Hare files, or begin a new draft.

steps.title: Complete guided hardware variables
steps.instructions: Use the printer, toolhead, and ERCF diagrams to fill required values.

steps.title: Review every preserved section
steps.instructions: Inspect board-specific pins, drivers, macros, additional steppers, and unknown options.

steps.title: Preview, back up, and apply or export
steps.instructions: Inspect every changed file. GKCC creates a backup before live updates and can export a review ZIP.

workflows.title: Jog, capture, and map a hardware location
workflows.summary: Home XYZ, move the toolhead with supervised small jogs, capture the live G-code position, and map it to Blobifier, Klicky, custom cfg variables, or a notebook-only record.
workflows.safety: Idle only. XYZ must be homed. Start above hardware, reduce step size near contact, and remain at the printer.

steps.title: Home and clear the path
steps.instructions: Home XYZ, verify the intended hardware state, and approach from a safe Z height.

steps.title: Jog to the physical reference
steps.instructions: Use 10 or 1 mm only in open space, then 0.1 or 0.01 mm near the reference point.

steps.title: Capture G-code coordinates
steps.instructions: Capture the coordinate that a direct G1 move would use and review any G-code origin offset.

steps.title: Map to cfg variables
steps.instructions: Choose the Blobifier, Klicky, or custom destination and review the transformed values.

steps.title: Review highlighted cfg lines
steps.instructions: Inspect the affected source lines and use the normal backup, diff, apply, and rollback workflow.

workflows.title: Complete Ellis-style tuning sequence
workflows.summary: Track mechanical preflight, extruder calibration, first layer, pressure advance, flow, cooling, retraction, and endurance verification.

workflows.title: Complete guided ERCF setup and calibration
workflows.summary: Track official installer output, hardware checks, selector, gear, encoder, cold pull, toolhead, Bowden, gates, load/unload, FlowGuard, and endurance tests.

workflows.title: Install and commission Blobifier
workflows.summary: Import the current Happy Hare addon files, verify wiring, test bucket switch and servo, measure tray/brush geometry, create a supervised first blob, tune, back up, and apply live.

workflows.title: Capture printer baseline
workflows.summary: Read the live Klipper configuration and save an as-built snapshot for the final manual.

steps.title: Confirm connection
steps.instructions: Klipper must report Ready. No machine movement is performed.

steps.title: Capture configuration
steps.instructions: Save the current Klipper configuration and relevant live status to the calibration record.

steps.title: Add baseline notes
steps.instructions: Record recent repairs, modifications, or known issues.

workflows.title: Toolhead sensors and first extrusion
workflows.summary: Baby-step filament, watch live sensor states, and mark entry, toolhead, and first-steady-extrusion positions.
workflows.safety: Only run while the printer is idle. Heat the nozzle before pushing filament through the nozzle. Keep hands clear of gears and the cutter.

steps.title: Prepare the toolhead
steps.instructions: Start with the correct gate selected. For physical geometry, use a clean/cold-pulled toolhead. Lock the tension/compression mechanism during Happy Hare geometry measurements.

steps.title: Mark extruder-entry sensor
steps.instructions: Advance slowly until the entry sensor changes state, then mark the position.

steps.title: Mark post-extruder toolhead sensor
steps.instructions: Continue through the extruder gears until the toolhead sensor changes state, then mark the position.

steps.title: Mark first steady extrusion
steps.instructions: Heat for the selected filament. Advance in small steps and mark the first continuous strand—not the first drool.

steps.title: Repeat and compare
steps.instructions: Run the measurement at least three times. The report will show the average and spread.

steps.title: Review results
steps.instructions: Compare measured values with current Happy Hare settings. This release records recommendations but does not edit configuration files.

workflows.title: Directional purge-volume samples
workflows.summary: Record outgoing/incoming filament pairs and the first visually clean stepped purge sample.

steps.title: Choose transition
steps.instructions: Select outgoing and incoming filament profiles.

steps.title: Produce stepped samples
steps.instructions: A later release will generate numbered purge tiles or strips.

steps.title: Select first clean sample
steps.instructions: Choose the first clean sample and apply a safety margin.
